name: research_area
description: One research agent. It researches one area with web search, and in every round a model from a different provider tries to refute each claim. It stops when the reviewer is satisfied or the round cap is reached, then writes its section of the report.

inputParameters.system:
You are one research agent on a team, and you own one area of a larger investigation. You have live web search. A different AI model, from a different company, will try to break every claim you report.

In every round:
1. Search the web before you answer, with up to 8 searches. Prefer primary sources such as statistics agencies, regulators, company filings, official documentation, standards bodies and peer-reviewed papers. Note each source's publication date.
2. Handle the reviewer's feedback first. For every claim in reviewerFeedback.challenges or reviewerFeedback.refutedThisRound, either revise it (keep the same id and bring better evidence) or retract it. Never add a refuted claim again.
3. Then add 3 to 8 new claims that answer keyQuestions and reviewerFeedback.gaps. Use reviewerFeedback.nextQueries as search leads, and don't repeat claims that are already in the ledger.

Every claim must be one checkable statement with specific numbers, dates or names where possible. It needs 1 to 4 sources that you opened in this session, written as full https:// URLs. Never invent, guess or shorten a URL. If you can't find a source, leave the claim out.

Reply with exactly one JSON object and nothing before or after it:
{"claims": [{"action": "add | revise | retract", "id": "C3 (only for revise or retract)", "claim": "", "evidence": "what the source says, with numbers and dates, in at most 2 sentences", "sources": ["https://..."], "confidence": "high | medium | low"}], "summary": "at most 3 sentences on what you found and what is still missing"}

inputParameters.queryExpression:
def arr: if type == "array" then . else [] end;
def clip($n): if type == "string" then (if length > $n then .[0:$n] + "..." else . end) else "" end;
def urls($k): [ (. // [] | arr)[] | select(type == "string") | select(test("^https?://")) ] | unique | .[0:$k];
. as $in
| ($in.round | tonumber) as $round
| ($in.ledger // {claims: [], refuted: [], nextId: 1}) as $L
| ($in.turn.ok == true) as $ok
| (if $ok then ($in.turn.data.claims // [] | arr) else [] end | map(select(type == "object"))) as $items
| ($items | map(select(.action == "retract") | .id)) as $retract
| ($items | map(select(.action == "revise" and .id != null))) as $revise
| ($items | map(select((.action // "add") == "add")
                | select(((.claim // "") | length) > 10)
                | select((.sources | urls(4) | length) > 0))) as $adds
| [ ($L.claims // [] | arr)[] | . as $c
    | select(($retract | map(select(. == $c.id)) | length) == 0)
    | ($revise | map(select(.id == $c.id))) as $rs
    | if ($rs | length) == 0 then $c
      else $rs[0] as $r
      | ($r.sources | urls(4)) as $u
      | $c + {claim: ($r.claim // $c.claim | clip(400)),
              evidence: ($r.evidence // $c.evidence | clip(300)),
              sources: (if ($u | length) > 0 then $u else $c.sources end),
              confidence: ($r.confidence // $c.confidence),
              status: "pending", round: $round, revisions: (($c.revisions // 0) + 1)}
      end ] as $kept
| [ range(0; $adds | length) as $k | $adds[$k]
    | {id: ("C" + (($L.nextId + $k) | tostring)),
       claim: (.claim | clip(400)),
       evidence: (.evidence | clip(300)),
       sources: (.sources | urls(4)),
       confidence: (.confidence // "medium"),
       status: "pending", round: $round, revisions: 0,
       lastReason: "", counterSources: []} ] as $added
| (($kept + $added) as $all
   | ($all | map(select(.status == "supported"))) + ($all | map(select(.status != "supported")))
   | .[0:24]) as $claims
| {ledger: {claims: $claims, refuted: ($L.refuted // [] | arr), nextId: ($L.nextId + ($adds | length))},
   reviewSet: [ $claims[] | select(.status != "supported")
                | {id, claim, evidence, sources, previousVerdict: .status, previousReason: .lastReason} ],
   supportedBrief: [ $claims[] | select(.status == "supported") | {id, claim: (.claim | clip(160))} ],
   researchOk: $ok,
   researcherSummary: (if $ok then (($in.turn.data.summary // "") | clip(600)) else "The researcher turn failed this round." end),
   stats: {added: ($added | length), revised: ($revise | length), retracted: ($retract | length)}}

inputParameters.system:
You are an adversarial fact-checker with live web search. Another AI agent, built on a model from a different company, wrote the claims in claimsToReview. Your job is to find what is wrong with them, not to agree with them.

For each claim in claimsToReview:
1. Open or search for its cited sources and check that they really say this, including the numbers, dates, scope and attribution.
2. Search independently for evidence that confirms or contradicts the claim.
Use up to 8 searches in total.

Give each claim one verdict:
- "supported" when credible evidence confirms it as stated
- "disputed" when sources conflict, only partly support it, or it is out of date
- "refuted" when it is false or the cited source doesn't support it
- "unverifiable" when you couldn't confirm it, because missing evidence never counts as support

Then judge how well the supported claims, including the ones in alreadySupported, answer keyQuestions:
- "gaps" lists the most important things that are still missing
- "nextQueries" lists 2 to 5 precise searches that would close those gaps
- "coverage" is a score from 0 to 100
- "sufficient" is true only when supported claims answer the keyQuestions with specific, sourced evidence

Reply with exactly one JSON object and nothing before or after it:
{"verdicts": [{"id": "C1", "verdict": "supported | disputed | refuted | unverifiable", "reason": "at most 2 sentences", "counterSources": ["https://..."]}], "gaps": [""], "nextQueries": [""], "coverage": 0, "sufficient": false, "critique": "at most 4 sentences"}

inputParameters.queryExpression:
def arr: if type == "array" then . else [] end;
def clip($n): if type == "string" then (if length > $n then .[0:$n] + "..." else . end) else "" end;
def urls($k): [ (. // [] | arr)[] | select(type == "string") | select(test("^https?://")) ] | unique | .[0:$k];
def verdict: if . == "supported" or . == "disputed" or . == "refuted" or . == "unverifiable" then . else "unverifiable" end;
. as $in
| ($in.round | tonumber) as $round
| ($in.minIterations | tonumber) as $min
| ($in.maxIterations | tonumber) as $max
| ($in.review.ok == true) as $rok
| (if $rok and (($in.review.data | type) == "object") then $in.review.data else {} end) as $R
| ($R.verdicts // [] | arr | map(select(type == "object")) | map(select((.id | type) == "string"))
   | map({key: .id, value: .}) | from_entries) as $V
| [ ($in.ledger.claims // [] | arr)[] | . as $c | $V[$c.id] as $v
    | if $v == null then $c
      else $c + {status: ($v.verdict | verdict), lastReason: ($v.reason | clip(300)),
                 counterSources: ($v.counterSources | urls(3)), reviewedRound: $round}
      end ] as $all
| ($all | map(select(.status == "refuted"))) as $newRef
| ($all | map(select(.status != "refuted"))) as $claims
| (($in.ledger.refuted // [] | arr) + ($newRef | map({id, claim: (.claim | clip(200)), reason: .lastReason, round: $round}))
   | .[-20:]) as $refuted
| ($claims | map(select(.status == "supported")) | length) as $s
| ($claims | map(select(.status == "disputed")) | length) as $d
| ($claims | map(select(.status == "unverifiable")) | length) as $u
| ($claims | map(select(.status == "pending")) | length) as $p
| (($in.prev.failedTurns // 0) + (if $in.researchOk == true then 0 else 1 end) + (if $rok then 0 else 1 end)) as $fails
| ($R.sufficient == true) as $suff
| ($round >= $min and $rok and $suff and $s >= 4 and ($d + $p) <= 3) as $gate
| ($fails >= 3) as $abort
| {ledger: {claims: $claims, refuted: $refuted, nextId: ($in.ledger.nextId // 1)},
   feedback: {gaps: ($R.gaps // [] | arr | map(clip(200)) | .[0:6]),
              nextQueries: ($R.nextQueries // [] | arr | map(clip(160)) | .[0:6]),
              challenges: ([ $claims[] | select(.status == "disputed" or .status == "unverifiable")
                             | {id, claim: (.claim | clip(200)), reviewer: .lastReason} ] | .[0:10]),
              refutedThisRound: [ $newRef[] | {id, claim: (.claim | clip(200)), reviewer: .lastReason} ],
              critique: ($R.critique // "" | clip(600))},
   progress: {round: $round, maxRounds: $max, supported: $s, disputed: $d, refuted: ($refuted | length),
              unverifiable: $u, pending: $p, coverage: ($R.coverage // null), sufficient: $suff,
              failedTurns: $fails, done: ($gate or $abort),
              researchOkRounds: (($in.prev.researchOkRounds // 0) + (if $in.researchOk == true then 1 else 0 end)),
              reviewOkRounds: (($in.prev.reviewOkRounds // 0) + (if $rok then 1 else 0 end)),
              outcome: (if $gate then "verified" elif $abort then "degraded" else "in_progress" end),
              phase: (if ($gate or $abort or $round >= $max) then "writing" else "researching" end),
              researcher: $in.prev.researcher, reviewer: $in.prev.reviewer}}

inputParameters.system:
You write one section of a research report from a fact-checked claim ledger.

- Supported claims are findings.
- Present disputed claims as contested, and give both sides.
- Mention refuted claims only in a final "Withdrawn after review" list, with the reviewer's reason.
- Cite every factual sentence with an inline markdown link to one of the claim's sources.
- Add no facts that aren't in the ledger.

Write 350 to 700 words. Start with an overview paragraph, then use these headings: "### Key findings", "### Contested or uncertain" and "### Open questions" (from openGaps). Add "### Withdrawn after review" only if a claim was refuted. Don't add a top-level heading.

inputParameters.title: ${workflow.input.area.title}
inputParameters.queryExpression:
def arr: if type == "array" then . else [] end;
def link: "[source](" + . + ")";
. as $in
| ($in.ledger.claims // [] | arr) as $claims
| ($claims | map(select(.status == "supported"))) as $sup
| ($claims | map(select(.status == "disputed"))) as $dis
| ($in.ledger.refuted // [] | arr) as $ref
| ($in.progress // {}) as $p
| (if ($p.researchOkRounds // 0) == 0 then "failed"
   elif ($p.reviewOkRounds // 0) == 0 then "unreviewed"
   elif ($sup | length) + ($dis | length) == 0 then "no findings"
   elif $p.outcome == "verified" then "verified"
   elif $p.outcome == "degraded" then "degraded"
   else "partially verified" end) as $status
| ({"failed": "the researcher's model failed in every round",
    "unreviewed": "the reviewer's model failed, so no claim was checked",
    "no findings": "no claim survived review"}[$status] // null) as $reason
| ([ $sup[], $dis[] | .sources // [] | arr | .[] ] | unique) as $sources
| (if $in.sectionOk == true and ($in.section | type) == "string" and ($in.section | length) > 200 then $in.section
   else "### Key findings\n\n"
        + ([ $sup[] | "- " + .claim + " " + ([ .sources // [] | arr | .[] | link ] | join(" ")) ] | join("\n"))
        + (if ($dis | length) > 0
           then "\n\n### Contested or uncertain\n\n" + ([ $dis[] | "- " + .claim + " (reviewer: " + (.lastReason // "") + ")" ] | join("\n"))
           else "" end)
   end) as $body
| {areaIndex: $in.areaIndex, title: $in.title, researcher: $in.researcher, reviewer: $in.reviewer,
   rounds: ($p.round // 0), status: $status, reason: $reason,
   stats: {supported: ($sup | length), disputed: ($dis | length), refuted: ($ref | length),
           unverifiable: ($claims | map(select(.status == "unverifiable")) | length)},
   sectionMarkdown: $body,
   claims: [ $sup[], $dis[] | {id, claim, status, sources} ],
   refuted: $ref,
   gaps: ($in.feedback.gaps // [] | arr),
   sources: $sources,
   progress: ($p + {phase: "done", status: $status})}
